headline: Fireworks AI breach exposes Notion customer data; N-central zero-days targeted; fresh ScreenConnect malware campaign

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports Notion customer data was compromised in the Fireworks AI hack (6 outlets); BleepingComputer says exposed data includes customer AI chat transcripts.
New: SecurityWeek reports a fresh ScreenConnect campaign deploying malware, on top of rogue-client attacks that hit at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations and breached MSPs.
New: Help Net Security reports stolen Claude API keys can turn Claude Code into a remote-controlled implant. Dark Reading also details an AI-driven attack against a US retailer.

Still active: hackers target N-central zero-days as N-able rushes patches (3 outlets); 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts ran a CI secret stealer in 1,806+ repos; Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618, no fixed release in the brief.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Due today 11-12: OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch, IBM Aspera Faspex.

Also on the board: Maersk data theft amid $5M WhiteArmor demand; Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; Vanderbilt ransomware lockdown (6 outlets); Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave exploited. SITCON 3 holds at 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: If you use Notion AI or Fireworks AI, check vendor notices and review what data and chat content you sent through them.
Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and hunt for malware dropped via remote sessions.
Treat Claude and other LLM API keys as high-value secrets: rotate any exposed in repos or CI and watch usage for anomalies.
N-central: apply N-able's patches as they ship and keep the console off the internet; rotate CI secrets in repos with unfamiliar workflow runs.
Find internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts with HTTP/2; restrict exposure and patch once a fixed release or distro package ships.
Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure fixes by 11-13; OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch, Aspera Faspex today; keep Xen Orchestra off the internet.
